summary: Can-Fite BioPharma announced a warrant exercise agreement generating approximately $4.0 million in gross proceeds. The company reduced the exercise price of 1,591,738 ADS warrants from $5.00 to $2.50 per ADS and issued new unregistered warrants for 3,183,476 ADSs at $2.50 each, exercisable for 24 months after a resale registration statement becomes effective. H.C. Wainwright acted as exclusive placement agent. Proceeds fund R&D and working capital. This is a capital-raising transaction, not a special situation; watch for potential dilution and the resale registration timeline.
